other_conditions: The applicant must be a girl student who has lost her father.
She must be a permanent resident of Madhya Pradesh.
She must be studying in a government school in Madhya Pradesh.
She must be enrolled in classes 1 to 12.
She must have passed the previous class.
She must not be a beneficiary of any other scholarship.
benefits_summary: Scholarships of ₹350 per year for classes 1‑5, ₹400 per year for classes 6‑8, and ₹450 per year for classes 9‑12, deposited directly into the student's bank account.
